evals.name: early-leave-team-lead
evals.prompt: write a whatsapp msg to my team lead Arvind: dentist appointment at 4 today so leaving at 3:30. the login-fix PR is merged, QA can test on staging. short
evals.expected_output: One short, friendly-professional message to Arvind with the 3:30 departure, the reason, and that the PR is merged and testable on staging. No preamble, no Markdown.
assertions: The message is addressed to Arvind
It says the user leaves at 3:30 for a dentist appointment
It mentions the merged login-fix PR and QA testing on staging
It is short (under ~4 lines) and has no Markdown

checks.why: the message comes first, no preamble
no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally

evals.name: cold-message-hinglish
evals.prompt: first whatsapp message to a photographer I found on instagram (@lensbyaman). my sister's engagement is on sun 6 dec in pune, need a quote for 4 hours candid photography. hinglish, casual
evals.expected_output: A casual Hinglish (Roman script) first message that introduces the user, says how they found the photographer, gives the date (Sun, 6 Dec), city (Pune), 4 hours candid, and asks for a quote.
assertions: Written in Hinglish in Roman script
Says how the user found the photographer (Instagram)
Includes 6 Dec, Pune and 4 hours of candid photography
Asks for a quote or price

checks.why: the message comes first, no preamble
no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally

evals.name: weekday-date-trap
evals.prompt: msg to landlord Mr. Kapoor: november rent ₹18,500 will reach on Friday 7 Nov because my salary is delayed this month, sorry. formal
evals.expected_output: A formal, apologetic message with the exact amount. 7 Nov 2026 is a Saturday, so the skill must not repeat 'Friday 7 Nov' as fact: it flags the mismatch in Notes or uses a placeholder/asks.
assertions: The weekday/date mismatch (7 Nov is a Saturday) is flagged to the user
Tone is formal and apologetic without over-explaining

checks.pattern: saturday|\bsat\b|doesn.t match|mismatch|isn.t a friday|not a friday
checks.why: flags that 7 Nov 2026 is a Saturday
no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally
